title: UTR Rating Season Leaderboard
dataSources: SwingVision sessions (`swingvision:session`), UTR rating history (`utr:rating`), racket-sport sessions (`racket:session`), stringing and maintenance events (`stringing:service`).
app: SwingVision match video analytics, UTR rating snapshots, court-session logs, and racket stringing reminders streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, CSV exports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=utr:rating
| stats avg(rating_value) as avg_value max(rating_value) as peak_value count as sessions by season
| sort - avg_value
description: Ranks season values by average and peak UTR rating, helping you see where utr rating performs best.
value: A simple leaderboard is an easy way to see which season contexts are producing the strongest outcomes without deep analysis.
implementation: Populate `season` consistently from your export pipeline so the leaderboard can compare like with like.
visualization: Leaderboard table of season, average UTR rating, and peak UTR rating.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which season areas give you the strongest utr rating results.
